reason: Exact: tiller is a synonym of PO:0005001 (an axillary shoot from the stem base, as in grasses). 'Present' and 'amount' are counts and presence of these shoots.

label: acanthophyll
definition: A leaflet (PO:0020049) of a pinnate palm leaf that is modified into a stiff, sharp spine; acanthophylls are borne on the proximal part of the leaf rachis, below the unmodified leaflets.
reason: A real structure (Phoenix and other palms) counted per side of the rachis, measured and described as reflexed in 3 floras. Spine leaf (PO_0025173) is a whole leaf with no lamina, so it does not fit. Could be proposed to PO, which has spine leaf, spine stipule and spine petiole but no spine leaflet.

target: calyx lobe (FLOPO_0986005), apex region (pinned BSPO apical region as part_restrictions filler)

Narrower: dichasium is a synonym of PO:0030126 (cyme inflorescence); a compound dichasium is a repeatedly branched one. Every statement is 'present', i.e. the inflorescence type.

The exine is the outer pollen wall. Its sculpture (foveolate, scabrous) is the surface sculpture of the pollen grain, which the surface pattern can express. PO has no wall layers; GO:0043668 exine exists if a class is ever needed.
Narrower: a sprout is a young shoot, here also a shoot from a rhizome. 'Shoot' is a synonym of PO:0009006. Root-borne shoot system (PO_0004544) would be too narrow for the hairiness statements.

Exact for a leaf blade: 'leaf lamina apex' is a synonym of PO:0020137. The examples (long acuminate, sommet arrondi) are leaf descriptions. If the blade belongs to a petal or lip, use that organ's apex instead.

label: cancellina
parent: is_a portion of plant tissue (PO_0009007); part_of non-vascular leaf (PO_0025075)
definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) formed of large, empty, hyaline cells in the sheathing base of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075), sharply set off from the green cells of the upper leaf; characteristic of Calymperaceae.
reason: A defined moss leaf structure, used in several moss floras for its distal outline (rounded, acute, truncate). PO has moss leaf parts (alar cell, costa) but not this one. Could be proposed to PO (bryophyte subset).

label: megaspore float
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is one of the spongy, buoyant bodies capping the megaspore (PO:0020019) inside the megasporocarp of Azolla, formed from the tapetal periplasmodium; the number of floats is diagnostic.
reason: Real and counted in 3 floras, but limited to Azolla. Keep in FLOPO; do not propose to PO unless PO extends its water-fern coverage.

definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a cup- or saucer-shaped receptacle on a thallus (PO:0030027) or at a gametophore apex in which gemmae (PO:0025614) are formed and held.

Narrower: an inner member of a series of petals. This follows the 'inner tepal' → tepal decision. The position is a series-position quality (pattern D).
